exact_claim: For the CA5-GNC-R canonical cell (pinned FINAL_ACTION.md eq. (4), hash b8c04d4e...) the extended spatial diffeomorphism generator H_i = -2 D_j pi^j_i + sum_A pi_A D_i phi_A + pi_U D_i U + pi_Z D_i Z + int_0^b dr[pi_W D_i W + pi_L D_i L] + pi_lambda0 D_i lambda0 (pi^j_i = pi^{jl} h_{li}, weight-1 density, density-weight-cancelled covariant divergence) satisfies, on the 1D periodic 4-site lattice (aux sector) and 2D 3x3 lattice (metric sector, h = delta + gamma, first-order connection): (C1) {G(xi),F} = L_xi F with residual exactly 0 for all 64 field/momentum tests; (C2) on the auxiliary primary surface pi_U=pi_Z=pi_W=pi_L=pi_lambda0=0 it reduces with residual exactly 0 to the physical momentum constraint -2 D_j pi^j_i + sum_A pi_A D_i phi_A (FINAL_ACTION.md (14)); (C3) it is first-class w.r.t. all 20 auxiliary primary constraints (brackets vanish on the surface, exact); (C5) the negative control fires: omitting the W,L terms leaves residual -xi.dW != 0 on off-shell heat fields while the full generator is exact (with witness and constant-field sharpness). Metric sector: M1 {h_ab,G}=L_xi h_ab exact to first order in gamma (27/27 O(eps) coefficients of the gamma->eps*gamma expansion = 0; residual O(gamma^2)); M2 {pi^ab,G}=L_xi pi^ab exact in the flat limit (27/27 residuals = 0 at gamma=0) with a quantified O(gamma) moment-map defect of the Gamma^(1)-truncated generator (all 27 linear coefficients recorded; the exact-inverse-metric engine restores the identity up to the O(Delta^2) lattice Leibniz defect, probe-verified for smooth fields); M3 gravity-only closure {Gg(xi),Gg(eta)} = Gg([xi,eta]) holds in the continuum limit - the lattice closure defects are the O(Delta^2) Leibniz defects of centered differences, measured to scale quadratically (relative defect 0.196 -> 0.0428 -> 0.00894 for 2*Delta = 1 -> 1/2 -> 1/4, ratios 4.59, 4.78), and the flat-limit M3 residual vanishes for smooth periodic fields (< 1e-16). Domain: finite periodic lattices; all residuals are exact rational/symbolic polynomials, not booleans. The claim is the generator structure + its reductions; it is NOT complete gravity closure and does not fix the action normalization beyond kappa=1/2 adopted.
